name: The Bandua Faithful

identity.symbol: A spear thrust through a humanoid skull
identity.public_perception: The backbone of Dravesa's defense. Respected by those who depend on the walls and the raids; resented by the Schismatics.

goals.primary: Maintain the seasonal raids on humanoid territories and keep Dravesa's fighting strength intact.
secondary: Keep Schismatic humanoid-tolerance preaching from reaching the steadings

philosophy.summary: The world has humanoids in it. Bandua gave humans the capacity to fight them. Failing to use that capacity is an insult to Bandua and a death sentence for the steadings. The seasonal raid is a religious obligation.
methods: Direct confrontation with Schismatic preaching when provoked
limits: Will not accept Schismatic converts into fighting training
Will not call off a raid on religious grounds

position.active_since: As long as Dravesa has had walls.

alliances.nature: Pragmatic. Shared opposition to the Schismatics. The Bandua find the Orthodox passive; the Orthodox find the Bandua crude. They work together anyway.

rivals.nature: The Schismatics are actively undermining steading participation in the seasonal raids. Two steadings have already refused to contribute fighters.

needs: Warden Keln to act against the Schismatics before Rakhmoth arrives
provides: The stone walls — built and maintained by Bandua faithful labor and pride

vraed-halman.name: Vraed Halman
vraed-halman.role: Warrior-priest. Runs the fighting hall. Commands the Bright-Scarred.

bright-scarred.name: The Bright-Scarred
bright-scarred.role: ~30 initiated fighters who have participated in at least one seasonal raid. Core of the militia.
bright-scarred.notes: Loyal to Vraed personally as much as to Bandua.

dm_notes: Vraed will take unilateral action against Telvari if Stravar keeps stalling — producing Schismatic martyrs and handing Rakhmoth a grievance on arrival. The party can either give him a productive direction or watch him cause the problem everyone is trying to avoid.
